title: Youdzhi's API
description: A simple yet effective API for all of my mods.
body:
This API is in public BETA test, and can be used by anyone, but please do not ask me how should you do this or that. Thank you.

# YOUDZHI'S API

API for making mods that are usually used by youtubers in their videos. It adds a little bit of everything: particles, epic text system, functions and glowing effect.

Smoother glowing effect was made by [MelonRind](https://modrinth.com/user/MelonRind) and is Licensed MIT.

Some particle images were found on itch.io, and some were made by me.
